body: The hand shovel and the scrub bucket are tied in one bundle with torn warning tape. A yellow tag with only a number on it hangs from the knot, and a stamp is smudged on the bucket.
title: Hand shovel and scrub bucket, late Wednesday

body: A farm truck carried sacks from the test plot, with yellow dust on the seams. A torn sack left a stripe across the dirt road, and the grass where it fell had withered by evening.
title: Sacks from the test plot
